overview: This uint8 enum marks a player-card nickname row as an upper-line or lower-line choice.

None.technical: FGameDataTableRow_PlayerCardNickname's constructor sets NicknameType to None. No exported nickname row uses None. BuildNicknameTiles removes every row whose NicknameType differs from TargetNicknameType, which is Top in the reconstructed C++ constructor, so a None row is filtered out of that choice list. Validate also requires the saved ID's row type to match the target slot.

Top.simple: The nickname shown on the upper line of the player card.
Top.technical: TargetNicknameType defaults to Top. SetupTiles then reads TopNicknameId, BuildNicknameTiles keeps only rows typed Top, and the fallback ID for that line is 3830. Validate replaces a saved TopNicknameId whose row is not typed Top with that same default. The export contains 1470 Top rows.

Bottom.simple: The nickname shown on the lower line of the player card.
Bottom.technical: When TargetNicknameType is Bottom, SetupTiles reads BottomNicknameId and BuildNicknameTiles keeps only rows typed Bottom. The fallback ID for that line is 23830, and Validate uses the same ID when a saved row is not typed Bottom. The widget C++ constructor sets Top, so the reconstructed source does not show which instance sets Bottom. The export contains 1470 Bottom rows.

Invalid.simple: An out-of-range marker that is filtered out of nickname choices.
Invalid.technical: The header declares Invalid as the out-of-range marker. No exported nickname row uses it. BuildNicknameTiles removes any row whose NicknameType differs from TargetNicknameType, so an Invalid row cannot appear in the reconstructed tile list. Validate requires the saved ID's row type to match Top or Bottom and substitutes the slot default when the check fails.

notes: The widget's C++ constructor sets TargetNicknameType to Top. The retail widget Blueprint instances are unavailable, so the Bottom assignment is inferred from the selection logic in SetupTiles.
Validate and the tile builder both require the row type to match the target slot. Validate substitutes 3830 or 23830 when the saved ID fails.
The export has 1470 Top rows and 1470 Bottom rows. None and Invalid are absent from the exported data.
